recentItems.title: Drawquarium - Official Launch Trailer
recentItems.description:
See the fish you can create, features, and gameplay from Drawquarium in this launch trailer for the sim game. Drawquarium is available now on Steam.

In Drawquarium, draw your very own fish and build a cozy little aquarium. And if you like, set it as your animated desktop wallpaper! Watch your drawings come to life. Feed them, raise them and collect golden scales to unlock new decorations. There are also some handy tools to help you focus and unwind.

recentItems.title: GTA 6 Is 30fps, but We Still Have Questions - Next-Gen Console Watch
recentItems.description: Welcome back to Next-Gen Console Watch! This week, Daemon, Ryan, and Nick take a look at Rockstar's somewhat surprising announcement that GTA 6 will be targeting 30 frames per second on all consoles—including the PS5 Pro. Many gamers, especially those who shelled out the extra bucks for the premium console, were more than a little annoyed that there won't be a 60fps or even 40fps performance mode on the Pro model. Considering the limitations of the Xbox Series X and the PS5 family, is this still acceptable in 2026? Should Rockstar have cut more corners to get 60 frames on the PS5 Pro? Plus we have some choice words from former Tekken boss Katsuhiro Harada about the Xbox Series S, and is Nintendo back in the graphics race following the success of the Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake?

recentItems.title: Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves - Official Laocorn Gaedeamus Trailer
recentItems.description:
Don't miss the trailer for Laocorn Gaedeamus, the latest DLC fighter of Season 3 for Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves! Appearing originally in Fatal Fury: The Motion Picture, the third animated Fatal Fury movie. Laocorn is now a fully playable character in City of the Wolves, featuring the Armor of Mars, the mystical artefact he sought out in the movie, as his Hidden Gear Attack! 
Laocorn Gaedeamus arrives in Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves on November 19th for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch 2, PC (Steam, Epic Games Store) and Xbox Series X|S.

recentItems.title: Rescue Drone Simulator: Second Chance - Official Gameplay Trailer | The MIX Fall Game Showcase 2026
recentItems.description:
Check out gameplay from Rescue Drone Simulator: Second Chance in this trailer for the upcoming flight sim game. Pilot drones into burning buildings, frozen landmarks, and collapsing tunnels. recentItems.title: Tanuki: Pon's Summer Review
recentItems.description:
Tanuki: Pon's Summer reviewed by Nicole Carpenter, played on PC (also available on PS4, PS5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 1 and 2).

"Tanuki: Pon's Summer launched just when it was needed most – as we head into the coldest months of the year. But it's a welcome reminder of joyful childhood summers during any time of the year, ones that were full of possibility and delight. Think of it as extreme sports delivery broken up with long stretches of roads to cruise down and minigame tasks, most of which are interesting diversions from Pon's mailman duties. Some of these minigames are monotonous and uninteresting, but they're over quick enough that it doesn't impact the game's pace too much. Over 10 hours of playtime, Tanuki: Pon's Summer is warm in both its environment and storytelling, packaged alongside simple, exciting BMX riding. Aside from a handful of lulls, though, the majority of Pon's busy vacation oozes with the warm thrill of summer that I'm finding myself daydreaming about when my toes get cold."

recentItems.title: Naughty Dog's Intergalactic Is in the 'Last Stages of Production' - IGN Daily Fix
recentItems.description:
In today's Daily Fix:
Integalactic: The Heretic Prophet is in the 'last stages of production,' according to developer Naughty Dog. Studio head Neil Druckmann also said the game is a mash-up of The Last of Us, Uncharted, and Jak and Daxter, if that gives you an idea of the style of gameplay the devs are going for. In other news, Marvel 1943: The Rise of Hydra is also nearing completion, but its long and troubled development caused the developers to cut content and the overall length of the game. And finally, Halo: Campaign Evolved is getting a Firefight mode, but not the multiplayer arena mode fans were hoping for.

recentItems.title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake - Where to Find All 10 Bean Plots
